patch.description: Current integrated matrix remains 73 configurations / 146 face requests, 56 accepted / 90 held. All 34 Polo and 56 Woven faces remain held. S359 measures unavoidable rigid Woven stand-to-neckline residual lower bounds above 0.25 cm in all 28 options and proposes, but does not implement, a full-collar view projection. Preserve the all-seven-recipe V02 criterion and keep V03 gated. See docs/research/epic17/G04-V02-WOVEN-COLLAR-RIGID-ASSEMBLY-S359.md and its linked diagnostics.
